arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Michael Fried argued the statute limits fees to spoken communication.
He cited the Court Interpreters Act as primary authority for this view.
Justice Sotomayor noted the dictionary definition includes translation work.
She asked why the Court should change existing practices.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the scope of 28 U.S.C. section 1920(6). The statute allows courts to award fees for interpreters. The parties disagree on whether this term includes written translation services.
